title: C: Event Bus
description: Implement a publish-subscribe event bus that allows listening to and emitting typed events (identified by integer IDs).

steps.title: Event Bus Core
steps.description: Define an `EventBus` struct with arrays of callbacks for up to 10 event types. Write `void eb_on(EventBus *eb, int event, void (*cb)(int, void*))` to register a callback and `void eb_emit(EventBus *eb, int event, void *data)` to emit an event. Test with 2 event types and 3 listeners.
hints: Also store count per event type.
emit calls all registered callbacks for that event.

verification.failureMessage: Emit both login and logout events
